=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1204-1226 (callers scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:130-137, 174-185; lease at pr_checks_lib.sh:2479-2483, 4031) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new wiring hook in `_pr_ensure_final_ci` also runs on the two exits that never merge (`ENABLE_AUTO_MERGE != true` at line 134 and `e2e-smoke-test` at line 181). On those exits it takes the base's merge lease in update mode through `_merge_lease_gate ... update` and pushes a branch update with `_pr_base_sync_for_fresh_ci` for a PR that will not merge.
  WHY: Other approved PRs on the same base get `MERGE_LEASE_OUTCOME=wait` / `ai:merge-lease-wait` until the lease TTL runs out. The e2e PR's head changes mid-gate, the race the e2e opt-out exists to prevent, so `reviewed_head_is_current_for_labels` fails closed. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2079-2085 (verify at 1842-1850 / 1926) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The verified-update path always sets `PR_FINAL_CI_WIRING_SKIP=true` before dispatching final CI. Verification only binds the update to the base SHA from the earlier compare (`PR_BASE_FRESHNESS_BASE_SHA`), not to the base tip at dispatch time.
  WHY: If the base gets a `ci.yml` change between verification and dispatch, the skip bypasses the wiring check. Final CI then runs a stale workflow copy against newer scripts, with no `REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WIRING` log line. Severity disagreement: gemini, minimax and luna said MAJOR; glm said NIT (narrow window that heals itself, confidence 2).
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1198-1216, 2406-2434 (caller scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:317-340) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the freshness side channel does not cover the head and no base ref is passed, which is always the case on the sweep path, each `_pr_ensure_final_ci` call makes one `GET pulls/<pr>` for the base ref and one `GET compare/<head>...<base>`.
  WHY: The sweep repeats this for every candidate on every tick, which breaks G4 ("one cached read of the base's workflow blob SHAs per cycle") and §14. Severity disagreement: gemini, minimax and luna said MAJOR; glm said NIT (capped at 10 candidates per sweep).
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2331-2333, 2407, 2476, 2500 (with scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:300-314, 340) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A held head (`recorded`, `update_branch_refused` or `merge_lease_*`) never gets a final CI run, so it stays a sweep candidate forever. Every tick repeats the pulls, compare, `GET user` and paginated comments reads (plus the lease read and label call for lease-held PRs) only to log the same hold again.
  WHY: This adds steady API traffic per held PR on every tick, against G4, §14 and §15. Severity disagreement: minimax said MAJOR; sonnet and glm said NIT.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2474-2498 (`_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update` update-refused branch; `_merge_lease_gate` same-PR check line 4110) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Two concurrent final-CI paths for the same head, the sweep and a review run's required-checks wait, can both pass the note_seen check and the same-PR lease. The loser's head-bound `PUT update-branch` is refused, and it posts the "GitHub refused to update the branch (for example, a merge conflict)" comment.
  WHY: The comment wrongly tells a human to resolve a conflict even though the other caller already updated the branch. Suggested fix: re-read `.head.sha` and skip the comment when it differs from `wiring_head`.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1756-1761 (`_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update` `held recorded` via `_pr_final_ci_wiring_note_seen`) | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: Any non-zero exit of `_pr_base_sync_for_fresh_ci`, including a transient 5xx that outlasts `gh_retry`, writes a permanent per-head hold marker. Later calls return `held recorded` without retrying.
  WHY: After one transient API failure, an approved PR with no conflict never gets a final CI run until a human updates the branch. Suggested fix: write the marker only when `mergeable == false`.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2331-2333 vs 1811-1816 (re-invoked at 2507) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: On the behind-and-updated path, `_pr_final_ci_wiring_note_seen` and `_pr_base_sync_count` each read `GET user` and the paginated issue comments, so both are fetched twice.
  WHY: Two redundant API calls per head. The function header's budget ("one `GET user` and one paginated issue-comments read") and the `_pr_base_sync_count` header claim at 1799-1801 are now false.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2367-2370 (header 2273-2276/2288; agents.d/9993-final-ci-wiring-behind.md) | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: On invalid input the helper logs `entry=invalid` (and `pr=invalid` / `head=invalid`), but the contractual `REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WIRING` prefix registered by this PR documents only `entry=dispatch|blocked_status`.
  WHY: The newly registered log contract drifts before merge. A future parser or heal rule built from the fragment would not expect `invalid`, though nothing parses it yet.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: G3, "A green head whose only ruleset blocker is a required status that its own workflow copy cannot post (for example `ci/final (missing)` from `_pr_ruleset_required_check_blockers`) is treated as 'branch behind in CI wiring' and goes through G1, instead of waiting forever."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh final-merge path (lines 15723-15763) and `_orch_squash_merge_bound` auto mode (lines 2626-2637), or a hook in scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh that these paths reach (e.g. `_pr_ruleset_required_check_blockers` or its caller at line 15733)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The G3 hook exists only in `_pr_sync_merge_blocked_guard` (pr_checks_lib.sh:858-862). The poller returns at orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15734-15737 when `_pr_ruleset_required_check_blockers` returns rc=1 (pr_checks_lib.sh:723, 731), before the guard call at 15757-15763. `_orch_squash_merge_bound` auto mode returns at line 2630 after `gh pr merge --auto` succeeds, before the guard at 2633. scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh never calls the guard. The guard is reached only from sync-mode merges (review_rb_judge.sh:2504, orchestrate_poll_process.sh:35772 / 2632-2633). `test_blocked_by_missing_ci_final_routes_to_update` (tests/test_review_final_ci.py) calls the guard directly and covers no real caller. orchestrate_poll_process.sh is outside the plan's files_touched.
- requirement: G3, "... goes through G1, instead of waiting forever." (no_run case: green head blocked by `ci/final (missing)` with no final CI run yet)
  expected_change_site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update` blocked_status branch (lines 2378-2392)
  confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The blocked_status logic continues only when `wiring_decision` is "exists success". When `wiring_runs` is empty, it logs `current/final_ci_no_run` and returns without starting the update, and no test covers a head with no runs that is blocked by `ci/final (missing)`.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh (hook in _pr_ensure_final_ci, lines 1204-1226; called from scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh lines 130-135 and 177-182) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The non-merge exits (`ENABLE_AUTO_MERGE != true` at line 134, `e2e-smoke-test` at line 181) now take the base's merge lease in update mode (`_merge_lease_gate`, line 2478, holder join 4029-4042, label at 4140) and push a base merge through `_pr_base_sync_for_fresh_ci`, for a PR that is never merged.
  WHY: The e2e PR's head changes mid-gate, and other approved PRs get `MERGE_LEASE_OUTCOME=wait` in `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` (line 2102). Suggested fix: `PR_FINAL_CI_WIRING_SKIP=true` on those exits.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update` update-refused branch; `_merge_lease_gate` line 4110 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The sweep (review_final_ci_sweep.sh line 340) and the required-checks wait (pr_checks_lib.sh line 1328) race for the same head. The loser's PUT is refused, and it posts a misleading "Final CI held ... refused ... merge conflict" comment and logs `held update_branch_refused`.
  WHY: The comment wrongly tells a human to resolve a conflict. Suggested fix: re-read `.head.sha` and skip the comment if it moved.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update` / lines 1756-1761 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Any refusal, including a transient 5xx, records a permanent hold marker for that head, and later calls return `held recorded` without retrying.
  WHY: A PR with no conflict stays deferred until a human acts. Suggested fix: write the marker only when `mergeable == false`.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh (with scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh lines 303-340); `_pr_ensure_final_ci` lines 1212-1214 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Held heads stay sweep candidates. Every tick spends a pulls read, a compare, a user read and a paginated comments read (plus a lease read and label call) to log the same hold again, and there is no per-cycle cache.
  WHY: Steady API traffic per held PR on every tick, against §14/G4.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_pr_final_ci_wiring_note_seen` vs `_pr_base_sync_count` (lines 1811 and 1816) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The token login and the comment listing are each read twice on the behind-and-updated path.
  WHY: Two redundant calls, and the documented §15 budget is wrong.
- agents.d/9993-final-ci-wiring-behind.md vs scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh invalid-input branch (around line 2369-2370) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The code can emit `entry=invalid` (and `pr=invalid` / `head=invalid`), but the contract documents only `entry=dispatch|blocked_status`.
  WHY: The newly registered contractual prefix already differs from its documentation.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Requirement: G3, "A green head whose only ruleset blocker is a required status that its own workflow copy cannot post (for example `ci/final (missing)` ...) ... goes through G1, instead of waiting forever."
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (lines 15729-15738) and `_orch_squash_merge_bound` auto mode (lines 2626-2631), or a hook in scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh those paths reach.
  Evidence of absence: The hook exists only in `_pr_sync_merge_blocked_guard` (lines 858-862). The poller returns at 15734-15737 before the guard at 15759, and auto mode returns at 2630 before the guard at 2633. The hook is reached only from review_rb_judge.sh line 2504 and orchestrate_poll_process.sh line 35772. The test calls the guard directly. orchestrate_poll_process.sh is not in files_touched.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (3 related items: SKIP on the auto-merge exits at lines 134/181; re-read head before the refused comment; document `invalid` in the fragment) | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
